_comment: Locked OSF-filing values for the Att. M-2 §2 second-branch reconstruction. See tariff_snapshot.md for full citations. Three of four values are taken from primary published sources; portfolio_sum_mw is the only stipulation (explicit per EXPERIMENT_DESIGN.md §6 with ±20% sensitivity band).

icc_capacity_rate.title: Capacity Charge — Supplement to Rate BESH and Rider PPO
icc_capacity_rate.tariff_id: ILL. C. C. No. 10, 71st Revised Informational Sheet No. 4
icc_capacity_rate.icc_docket: Spring Procurement Charges filing 2026-04-24 (Index of Filings 2026 p. 4)
icc_capacity_rate.issued_by: David R. Perez, EVP and COO, Commonwealth Edison Company
icc_capacity_rate.url: https://www.icc.illinois.gov/ (ComEd Schedule of Rates for Electric Service)

pjm_wn_peaks.title: PJM Weather-Normalized Peaks (historical, by zone and delivery year)

pjm_5cp_zonal.title: PJM Annual 5CP PDF — ComEd zonal loads at the five PJM RTO peaks
pjm_5cp_zonal.publisher: PJM (annual, summer Y peaks published mid-October Y)

pjm_oatt_att_m2_comed.title: PJM OATT Attachment M-2 (ComEd) — Determination of Capacity Peak Load Contributions
pjm_oatt_att_m2_comed.note: Defines the CPLC_(Y+1) two-branch formula. Portfolio_sum is the denominator of branch 2 and is computed by ComEd across customers; not separately published as a public scalar.

ComEdNPL_mw_by_year._source: pjm_wn_peaks xlsx, COMED zone, SUMMER, Delivery Year column
ComEdNPL_mw_by_year._note: 2026 and 2027 use the most recent published value (2025) as the locked baseline. Replace with PJM's actual filed value for the corresponding planning year when published (typically January of the year before).

AComEdCPL_mw_by_year._source: Mean of pjm.coincident_peak.comed_zone_load_mw across the 5 PJM 5CP hours per summer year, from PJM's annual 5CP PDF
AComEdCPL_mw_by_year._note: 2026 and 2027 use most recent value (2025) as the locked baseline. Re-derive from pjm.coincident_peak after PJM publishes the corresponding summer's 5CP PDF (mid-October).

portfolio_sum_mw_by_year._source: STIPULATED — Σ_5Pc(ACustPL − ACustCPL) is computed by ComEd across customers and is not separately published. Per EXPERIMENT_DESIGN.md §6 Layer 2 is descriptive and reported with sensitivity.
portfolio_sum_mw_by_year._estimation_note: Anchored on (ComEdNPL − AComEdCPL) system-wide gap which is 1,500-3,000 MW for recent years; portfolio_sum is restricted to branch-2 customers and is therefore SMALLER than that system gap. Best estimate ~1,500 MW with ±20% sensitivity reported alongside.
portfolio_sum_mw_by_year._sensitivity_band: ±20% (widened from spec's ±10% to reflect the stipulation nature)

capacity_rate_dollars_per_kw_month_by_ye._source: ComEd ICC Informational Sheet 4 (71st Revised), tariff_source.icc_capacity_rate
capacity_rate_dollars_per_kw_month_by_ye._note_2026: Locked: $10.13567/kW-Month, applies to billing periods June 2026 through May 2027 per Info Sheet 4.
capacity_rate_dollars_per_kw_month_by_ye._note_2027: Placeholder using 2026/27 value; ComEd files the 2027/28 program-year MCC in approximately April 2027. Re-lock when published.
